def diagnose_capability_failure(
    *,
    capability_code: str,
    registered_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str],
    loaded_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str],
    runtime_aligned: bool,
    error_code: str = "",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Differentiate capability, runtime drift, contract, request, RBAC, context, and transient errors.

    Never misclassifies INVALID_ARGUMENT as stale runtime.
    """
    code = str(capability_code or "").strip().upper()
    err = str(error_code or "").strip().upper()
    reg = {str(c).strip().upper() for c in registered_capabilities if str(c).strip()}
    loaded = {str(c).strip().upper() for c in loaded_capabilities if str(c).strip()}

    if any(tok in err for tok in ("RBAC", "INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE", "FORBIDDEN", "UNAUTHORIZED", "ACCESS_DENIED")):
        classification = "RBAC_INSUFFICIENT"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif any(tok in err for tok in ("BOUNDED_CONTEXT", "CONTEXT_INVALID")):
        classification = "CONTEXT_INVALID"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif any(tok in err for tok in ("CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED", "MODE_MISMATCH", "SCHEMA", "CONTRACT")):
        classification = "CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif any(tok in err for tok in ("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "INVALID_JOB_ID", "JOB_ID_INVALID", "OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED", "VALIDATION_ERROR")):
        classification = "INVALID_REQUEST"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif any(tok in err for tok in ("TIMEOUT", "CONNECTION", "LOCK_BUSY", "TEMPORARY", "TRANSIENT")):
        classification = "TRANSIENT_ERROR"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif code and code in reg and code not in loaded:
        classification = "CAPABILITY_NOT_LOADED_STALE_RUNTIME"
        requires_runtime_recovery = True
    elif code and code not in reg:
        classification = "CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False
    elif not runtime_aligned:
        classification = "RUNTIME_STALE"
        requires_runtime_recovery = True
    else:
        classification = "HEALTHY_OR_UNCLASSIFIED"
        requires_runtime_recovery = False

    return {
        "capability_code": code,
        "error_code": err,
        "classification": classification,
        "requires_runtime_recovery": requires_runtime_recovery,
        "in_registered_catalog": code in reg if code else False,
        "in_loaded_runtime": code in loaded if code else False,
        "runtime_aligned": bool(runtime_aligned),
        "production_touched": False,
    }


def build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report(
    *,
    loaded_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read-only convergence snapshot across Git HEAD, Worker runtime, Python import tree, and MCP catalog."""
    import sys

    fp = build_runtime_fingerprint()

    def _safe_rev(ref: str) -> str | None:
        try:
            val = _git("rev-parse", ref).lower()
            return val if _SHA_RE.fullmatch(val) else None
        except RuntimeFingerprintError:
            return None

    remote_dev_sha = _safe_rev(f"origin/{DEV_BRANCH}")
    worker_health_sha = _safe_rev("origin/worker/health")
    head_aligned = bool(remote_dev_sha and fp["development_sha"] == remote_dev_sha)

    try:
        from modules.worker_ingress.semantic_capabilities import registered_capabilities as _reg_caps

        registered = tuple(sorted(_reg_caps()))
    except Exception:
        registered = ()

    loaded = (
        tuple(sorted({str(c).strip().upper() for c in loaded_capabilities if str(c).strip()}))
        if loaded_capabilities is not None
        else registered
    )
    missing_in_runtime = sorted(set(registered) - set(loaded))
    catalog_aligned = len(missing_in_runtime) == 0

    overall_converged = bool(
        head_aligned
        and fp["worker_code_tree_aligned"]
        and fp["generation_aligned"]
        and catalog_aligned
    )
    if overall_converged:
        recommended_action = "NONE"
    elif not head_aligned:
        recommended_action = "ALIGN_HEAD_FIRST"
    else:
        recommended_action = "RECOVER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME"

    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-runtime-convergence.v1",
        "branch": fp["branch"],
        "local_head": fp["development_sha"],
        "remote_development_head": remote_dev_sha,
        "head_aligned": head_aligned,
        "worker_code_tree_sha": fp["worker_code_tree_sha"],
        "active_worker_code_tree_sha": fp["active_worker_code_tree_sha"],
        "worker_code_tree_aligned": fp["worker_code_tree_aligned"],
        "expected_generation": fp["expected_generation"],
        "actual_generation": fp["actual_generation"],
        "generation_aligned": fp["generation_aligned"],
        "worker_health_ref": worker_health_sha,
        "python_executable": sys.executable,
        "pythonpath": os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        "virtual_env": os.environ.get("VIRTUAL_ENV", ""),
        "import_root": str(ROOT),
        "registered_capabilities": list(registered),
        "loaded_capabilities": list(loaded),
        "missing_in_runtime": missing_in_runtime,
        "catalog_aligned": catalog_aligned,
        "overall_converged": overall_converged,
        "recommended_action": recommended_action,
        "recovery_script": "tools/bootstrap/recover_preview_runtime.sh",
        "production_touched": False,
    }

"""Gate B.1 tests: Runtime MCP & Capability Catalog convergence diagnostics."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi import HTTPException

from tools.mirror_sync import worker_runtime_fingerprint as fp
from modules.worker_ingress import routes as ingress_routes


def test_diagnose_capability_failure_differentiates_all_8_classes():
    reg = ("READ_ONLY_CANARY", "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED")
    loaded = ("READ_ONLY_CANARY",)

    # 1. Capability registered in code but not loaded in active runtime
    d1 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=loaded,
        runtime_aligned=True,
    )
    assert d1["classification"] == "CAPABILITY_NOT_LOADED_STALE_RUNTIME"
    assert d1["requires_runtime_recovery"] is True

    # 2. Capability genuinely unknown
    d2 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="NONEXISTENT_CAP",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=True,
    )
    assert d2["classification"] == "CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN"
    assert d2["requires_runtime_recovery"] is False

    # 3. INVALID_ARGUMENT MUST NEVER be misclassified as stale runtime
    d3 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=loaded,
        runtime_aligned=False,
        error_code="INVALID_ARGUMENT",
    )
    assert d3["classification"] == "INVALID_REQUEST"
    assert d3["requires_runtime_recovery"] is False

    # 4. Contract incompatible
    d4 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="READ_ONLY_CANARY",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=True,
        error_code="SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED",
    )
    assert d4["classification"] == "CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE"

    # 5. RBAC insufficient
    d5 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=True,
        error_code="RBAC_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN",
    )
    assert d5["classification"] == "RBAC_INSUFFICIENT"

    # 6. Context invalid
    d6 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="REPOSITORY_CONTRACT_AUDIT",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=True,
        error_code="SEMANTIC_BOUNDED_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED",
    )
    assert d6["classification"] == "CONTEXT_INVALID"

    # 7. Transient error
    d7 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="READ_ONLY_CANARY",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=True,
        error_code="GIT_LOCK_BUSY",
    )
    assert d7["classification"] == "TRANSIENT_ERROR"

    # 8. Runtime stale when code tree drifted
    d8 = fp.diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code="READ_ONLY_CANARY",
        registered_capabilities=reg,
        loaded_capabilities=reg,
        runtime_aligned=False,
    )
    assert d8["classification"] == "RUNTIME_STALE"
    assert d8["requires_runtime_recovery"] is True


def test_build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report_detects_missing_runtime_capability(monkeypatch):
    sha = "a" * 40
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        fp,
        "build_runtime_fingerprint",
        lambda: {
            "schema": "edarsahub.worker-runtime-fingerprint.v1",
            "branch": "Edarsahub_Desarrollo",
            "development_sha": sha,
            "worker_code_tree_sha": "b" * 40,
            "active_worker_code_tree_sha": "b" * 40,
            "worker_code_tree_aligned": True,
            "expected_generation": "v4",
            "actual_generation": "v4",
            "generation_aligned": True,
            "required_capabilities": [],
            "production_touched": False,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(fp, "_git", lambda *args: sha)

    report = fp.build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report(loaded_capabilities=["READ_ONLY_CANARY"])
    assert report["schema"] == "edarsahub.worker-runtime-convergence.v1"
    assert report["head_aligned"] is True
    assert report["catalog_aligned"] is False
    assert "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED" in report["missing_in_runtime"]
    assert report["overall_converged"] is False
    assert report["recommended_action"] == "RECOVER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME"
    assert report["production_touched"] is False


def test_runtime_convergence_route_enforces_rbac_scope(monkeypatch):
    def deny(**kwargs):
        raise ingress_routes.OAuthValidationError("INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE")

    monkeypatch.setattr(ingress_routes, "enforce_internal_jwt_mcp_scope", deny)
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc_info:
        ingress_routes.read_worker_runtime_convergence(
            current_user={"id": "2", "email": "op@example.com", "role": "Operador"},
            authorization="Bearer invalid",
        )
    assert exc_info.value.status_code == 403

objective: Gate B.1 (Master Autonomous Program V1): Convergencia verificable entre codigo HEAD, runtime activo del Worker/MCP, PYTHONPATH/venv y catalogo de capacidades registradas; diagnostico diferenciado de 8 clases sin confundir INVALID_ARGUMENT con runtime obsoleto; endpoint protegido GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence.
